recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast duotone composition featuring a figure suspended upside down in mid-air over a body of water, characterized by a vibrant red and pale peach color palette with heavy film grain and bold, slanted typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: The figure's dynamic V-shape legs contrast with the flat horizontal line of the water.
The bold black display text anchors the top left corner against the light sky.
The monochromatic red shadows in the water mirror the red tones of the figure's clothing.
coreInvariants: Strict duotone or tritone color palette (Red, Peach/Cream, Black).
Heavy, visible film grain or halftone-like texture.
Central figure in a state of falling or suspension.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central figure positioned vertically, head pointing downward toward the bottom third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, bold display text in the upper left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, follows the diagonal of the legs down to the head, and rests on the textured water surface.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample open space in the upper two-thirds representing the sky, rendered in a flat peach tone.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant mid-tone red for shadows and water.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds against a low-saturation background; high value contrast between sky and text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy italic display paired with a light, tracked-out secondary sans-serif for contrast.
graphicDevices: Circular emblem/logo container in the top left corner.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the display text.
Provides a similar industrial, bold sans-serif feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, duotone photograph in red and peach. The image features a woman in a light-colored dress falling upside down in mid-air. Below her is a dark, textured sea with a sharp horizon line. The sky is a flat, pale peach color with heavy film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold, black, condensed italic sans-serif title in the top left. Below it, add a secondary line of text in white, uppercase, with wide tracking. Include a circular graphic icon to the left of the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly limited to red, peach, and black?
Is the grain texture prominent across the entire image?
Is the main text heavily slanted and condensed?
Is the horizon line perfectly horizontal?

mustRedesign: Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red does not bleed into the peach sky excessively.
Ensure the text is legible against the background.
Verify the figure appears to be falling, not floating.
Confirm the grain does not obscure the primary shapes.
recipe.reuseFormula: Duotone Action + Grainy Sky + Bold Italic Header
